---
name: Feature request
about: A new source, device, LLM backend, metric or screen
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**The use case**
What you want to see or do, and why. One or two sentences on your setup (devices, how you sync)
help more than a long list.

**Data involved**
Which tables or files this touches (if you know), and whether the data already reaches wristpull
or needs a new importer.

**Privacy**
Does the feature send data anywhere? wristpull's rule: nothing leaves the machine unless the user
chose a cloud backend explicitly.
